# Power_Density_Law

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A scaling principle stating that as transistor density increases, power density becomes the primary limiter, shifting focus to energy-efficient architectures and 3D thermal management. Drives TCC/iNEST toward energy-aware interconnect topologies and spiking/neuromorphic designs that minimize data movement and power hotspots.
